why: tools/catalogue/build_lesson_order.py's term-and-style quote limb was narrowed in #586 to the term·week token derived from SCIENCE_WEEK_BINDINGS. Measured across all 129 shelf decks, that narrowing removed a proof that existed on 11 of them. The loss is LATENT: the limb only runs when a deck's bytes drift from its recorded evidence sha256, and none of these currently do. A drift on a fenced deck drops its week binding SILENTLY, because none of them is style:recommended and so none raises. The fallback limb that repairs this lands in the NEXT release.
rule: No pull request may modify, rename or delete a fenced path until the fallback limb has landed and this file is retired. tools/verify_cross_estate_unification.py enforces this against the PR's own diff.
retireWhen: the fallback limb lands with both red proofs: the no-week arm and the label-form arm, the latter including a wrong-label case.
